name: A Brief History Lesson
summary: You are sent to Shen'dralas to hear about the crystals you repaired. Their lights have drawn concern, and an explanation is waiting.

sections.title: Questions in Shen'dralas
sections.body: The crystals you repaired have raised questions, and you are sent to Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas for answers. The skies have taken on a dramatic appearance, adding to the unease around the earlier requests.

sections.title: A Visit Planned
sections.body: Mordent says his silence came from excitement at seeing the crystals shine again. He hopes to visit the temple of Shen'dralas, though he lacks the courage to speak with the Shen'dralar there.

faq.q: Who is supposed to explain the crystals?
faq.answer: Mordent Evenshade in Shen'dralas is asked to explain the crystals you repaired.

faq.q: Why did the earlier requests seem suspicious?
faq.answer: The requests came without context, and the skies had taken on a dramatic appearance.

faq.q: Why did Mordent leave out the explanation?
faq.answer: Mordent says he was eager to see the crystals' lights shine again and failed to explain the situation from the start.

faq.q: Does Mordent plan to visit the temple?
faq.answer: Mordent is excited to visit the temple of Shen'dralas again, though he says it may take time before he can speak with the Shen'dralar there.
